title: Super Mario Franchise Overview
body:
Super Mario began with arcade and console games created at Nintendo, with the character's first appearances in the early 1980s and the landmark Super Mario Bros. released in 1985, followed by decades of platform, kart, party and sports games documented in public release records.

This public edition records only verifiable facts — game titles, developers, release years and formats — in original wording, with no copied game text or music.

The companion Signature edition is separate, labeled unofficial fiction with original heroes and kingdoms, and it claims no affiliation with or endorsement by Nintendo.

How to use this record: start with the overview, then read the work-by-work records in publication order. Every date and credit below is a public fact; no copyrighted text is reproduced anywhere in this database.

title: Super Mario Reading and Viewing Order Guide
body:
Recommended public order for the works in this database is publication and release order, beginning with Super Mario Bros. (1985) and ending with The Super Mario Bros. Movie (2023). That order follows how the franchise actually reached the public, and it avoids assuming any later reordering.

The full order is: Super Mario Bros. (1985); Super Mario Bros. 3 (1988); Super Mario World (1990); Mario Kart (1992); Super Mario 64 (1996); Super Mario Sunshine (2002); Super Mario Galaxy (2007); New Super Mario Bros. Wii (2009); Super Mario Odyssey (2017); The Super Mario Bros. Movie (2023). Each title in that list has its own record in this database with its credited creators and format.

This guide contains facts only. It does not reproduce story text, and it does not claim that any Signature continuation belongs in the official order.
